from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitMetric(BaseModel):
    """One company's reported 'deducted non-recurring net profit' for the period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name as named in the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code if provided")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g. 2024 年第一季度")
    deducted_non_recurring_net_profit: float | None = Field(description="The '归属于上市公司股东的扣除非经常性损益的净利润' value in yuan; can be negative")
    source_section: str | None = Field(description="Where this metric was found, e.g. 主要会计数据和财务指标")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_metrics: list[CompanyProfitMetric]
